name: Guilmon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 [Evil], [Dark Dragon], [Evil Dragon] or [Dark Knight] trait card or purple Tamer card to the hand and trash 1 such card. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon.
